_note: Made-up example sequence for the fictional seller Ledgerline.

sequences.who: Controllers at in-ICP accounts with a playable signal from the last 90 days

company.description: Account name as people say it

trigger_fact.description: One sourced, dated fact in plain words
trigger_fact.example: you are hiring an AP lead

steps.subject: {{company}} month end
steps.body: Hi {{first_name}}, I saw {{trigger_fact}}. When a finance team adds people, month end often gets slower before it gets faster. Finance teams on Ledgerline close the month 3 days sooner. Is close speed something you are working on this quarter?
Call reason: {{trigger_fact}}. Ask how month end runs today and who owns approvals.

{{first_name}}, one more thought. New hires in finance usually inherit the approval process as it is. If approvals at {{company}} still run through inboxes, a short look at how others set them up could help. Would that be useful?
Hi {{first_name}}, I work with finance teams on month end and saw {{trigger_fact}}. Happy to connect.

stop_rules: reply from anyone at the same account stops every sequence there
